slides.texte_overlay:
Unusual skills every
dangerous man quietly has

1. Cleaning and cooking
a fish he caught
River to plate.
No store needed.

2. Paddling a canoe
in a straight line
Harder than it looks.
Calm strokes, steady head.

3. Calming a scared dog
Low voice, slow hands,
no eye contact.
Panic is contagious. So is calm.

4. Typing fast
without looking
Work gets done
while others hunt for keys.

5. Reading the sky
Red sky at night, dry tomorrow.
He knows before the app does.

6. A few words in
five languages
Hello, thank you, sorry.
Doors open everywhere.
